NLM MBR reference material, now served only through an Archive-It wrapper

sources.observation: The documented mbr.nlm.nih.gov host did not resolve. The surviving Lister Hill URL redirected to an Archive-It HTML capture rather than a raw baseline file.
sources.next_action: Ask NLM Support whether raw annual baseline XML for 2006, 2010, 2011, and 2012 remains obtainable, and record exact file URLs and checksums before changing this status.

evidence.label: NLM MeSH data downloads and archive of prior production years

sources.observation: All required descriptor archives were downloaded as raw gzip bytes, parsed as MeSH XML, counted, and pinned by SHA-256.
sources.next_action: Use these pinned vocabularies to adjudicate candidate descriptor mappings; do not call a mapping period-appropriate until matching historical citation records are also pinned.
